card.name: Phone numbers and 'check back' phrases
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces or dots partway through a telephone number in contact details, and the word 'back' or 'check' in 'check back' invitations on web pages.

modes.label: Inside phone numbers
modes.description: A digit or gap in the middle of a telephone number after Tel or a contact line.

modes.label: Check back later
modes.description: The word back or check in an invitation to revisit a page or look at a link.
